title: 思考一個問題為什麽你在變優秀 變得越來越好，但是你game的女生Lev依然沒什麽變化？

timeline.summary: The speaker describes a viewer who has improved income and appearance but believes his dating results have stagnated or worsened.

He diagnoses the problem as avoiding women he ranks as higher-status, losing composure around them, and staying within a lower-pressure comfort zone; he asserts that results with one high-ranked woman are more useful than many lower-ranked results.
He distinguishes external value from self-worth and proposes a feedback loop in which feeling unworthy leads to downward social selection, whose low-quality feedback then reinforces low self-worth.
He proposes refusing downward socializing, pursuing and 'conquering' higher-ranked women, and using repeated outcomes to strengthen self-worth.
He says upward socializing may require breaking class barriers and techniques, then closes with a channel promotion rather than evidence of the method's effectiveness.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He distinguishes improved income, appearance, clothing and physique from a person's felt self-worth.
claims.conditions: The distinction is presented in the dating context; the clip does not provide a validated measure of either construct.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He says feeling unworthy around a person one ranks highly can reduce composure and natural self-expression and encourage avoidance.
claims.conditions: This is his explanation of a pattern, not a diagnosis; anxiety, preference, compatibility, discrimination, opportunity and many other causes are not assessed.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He describes a self-reinforcing loop in which selecting only low-pressure partners yields feedback he considers low quality and further lowers self-worth.
claims.conditions: The loop is asserted without shown cases or outcomes and depends on a demeaning one-dimensional ranking of women.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He recommends rejecting women he ranks low, repeatedly pursuing women he ranks high, and using outcomes to build self-worth.
claims.conditions: Recorded as a high-risk speaker prescription only; it objectifies people, makes self-worth contingent on outcomes, and gives no evidence of consent, reciprocity, safety or effectiveness.

speaker_attribution.speaker: Mikey
speaker_attribution.basis: The same channel host appears alone and speaks to camera across all 57 sampled frames; no second speaker or inserted audio is visible.

visual_findings: All 57 sampled frames show one man in a black top against the same curtain with embedded subtitles.
The video shows no women, dates, social outcomes, private messages, statistics or other evidence for the ranking and feedback-loop claims.

permissions.reason: The usable external-value/self-worth and equality principles are already formal; the added ranking and conquest prescription is unsafe and unsupported.

limitations: Sparse sampled frames are not continuous audio-visual review.
Several ASR phrases are corrupt, especially S00002, S00015, S00018, S00022, S00029, S00036 and S00058.
No recipient reaction or outcome is shown.
The labels high-score, low-score, upward and downward socializing are the speaker's hierarchy, not established facts about the people discussed.
